title: Scheduled reports
subtitle: Check websites automatically: site analytics and SEO audits with saved reports.
name: Schedule name
targetsHelp: Enter each website on a new line. Use a domain or page URL. A separate report of the selected type is created for each website.
targetsOnePerLine: Enter each website on a new line, without spaces.
invalidTargets: Use a domain or HTTP/HTTPS URL without a username, password, or port number.
periodHelp: A new website check runs at the selected time. Monthly checks run on the first of the month.
dataHelp: Reports show the website's state when it is checked. Saved versions let you compare results across runs.
quotaHelp: Each new report for one website uses one credit from the selected type's daily limit: site analytics or SEO audit. Viewing saved reports does not use credits.
websiteHelp: Reports remain available on the website whether Telegram delivery is enabled or not.
botHelp: Link your Telegram account and enable automatic file delivery in bot settings to receive reports.
botExportsHelp: Enable automatic file delivery in bot settings. Until then, reports are saved on the website.
created: Schedule created. Reports will appear after the first run.
queued: Report generation queued. The results will appear in history.
error: Unable to load or update reports. Please try again.
limitReached: The schedule limit has been reached. Delete a schedule to add another.
emptySchedules: Create a schedule to check websites automatically.
confirmDelete: Delete this schedule? Automatic generation will stop. Saved reports will remain available.
emptyHistory: No reports yet. Wait for the scheduled run or select Generate now.
reportFailed: This report could not be generated. Check the website availability and generate it again.
